description: This file defines the BuzzLikeOnShare entity class, which represents a 'like' on a shared item within the OrangeHRM Buzz module. It includes properties for the share, the employee who liked it, and the timestamp of the like, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnShare
classes.description: Entity class representing a 'like' action on a shared post in the OrangeHRM Buzz module, with properties for share, employee, and timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the like record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the like record.

methods.name: getShare
methods.description: Returns the BuzzShare entity associated with this like.

methods.name: setShare
methods.description: Associates a BuzzShare entity with this like.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity who liked the share.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity who liked the share.

methods.name: getLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Returns the DateTime when the like was made, in UTC.

methods.name: setLikedAtUtc
methods.description: Sets the likedAtUtc property to the current UTC time.
